title: 100 ming funtlik patent qaysi avtomobil brendini tug'di?
hook: 1929 yilda bitta patent 100 ming funtga sotildi.

scenes.text: 1929 yilda yapon ixtirochisi Sakichi Toyodaning to'quv dastgohi patenti huquqlari 100 ming funtga sotildi.
Bu dastgoh 1924 yilda yaratilgan. U ishni to'xtatmasdan mokini o'zi almashtirardi.
Huquqlarni Britaniyaning Platt Brothers kompaniyasi sotib oldi.
Sakichining o'g'li Kiichiro Toyoda bu mablag'ni avtomobil yaratishga yo'naltirdi.
1937 yilda Toyota Motor kompaniyasi tuzildi. Uning ildizi to'quv dastgohida edi.

description:
Sakichi Toyoda 1924 yilda G turidagi avtomatik to'quv dastgohini yaratgan. 1929 yilda uning patent huquqlari (Yaponiya, Xitoy va AQShdan tashqari hududlar uchun) Britaniyaning Platt Brothers kompaniyasiga 100 ming funtga sotilgan, o'g'li Kiichiro esa bu mablag'ni avtomobil ishiga yo'naltirgan. Toyota Motor 1937 yilda tuzilgan.

Sizning birinchi ishingiz nimadan boshlangan? Izohda yozing.
source: Fact-checked 2026-11-23 (web-search summaries; pages did not open). TRUE: Type G automatic loom 1924 (shuttle change without stopping); Platt Brothers paid GBP 100,000 in 1929 for the patent rights (about 1 million yen); Science Museum Group says the licence fees helped launch Toyota Motor; Toyota Motor Co. founded 1937. FIXED: 'Uning o'g'li' was ambiguous (could read as Platt's son), now 'Sakichining o'g'li'; 'patent' clarified as patent rights; territory limit added to the description (Platt's rights excluded Japan, China and the US). One site (EBSCO) gives '$150,000', treated as an error. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Platt_Brothers ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakichi_Toyoda ; https://www.tcmit.org/vgt/car/english/scene-01-iframe/target-05/ ; https://collection.sciencemuseumgroup.org.uk/objects/co528175/toyoda-automatic-loom ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiichiro_Toyoda
